checks.name: Actual component responsibility
checks.result: ReferencePNG.metadataFree is a filter for freshly encoded single-image PNG derivatives. It is not an encoder or arbitrary-source decoder. Its documented contract delegates pixel and CRC validation to the platform codec.

checks.name: Input size, signature and framing
checks.result: Input byte count is limited before the UInt8 copy. Signature is checked, every iteration requires at least 12 remaining bytes, and payload length must fit the remaining bytes before chunk end is computed.

checks.name: Offset overflow bounds
checks.method: Static source review for documented 64-bit iOS platform
checks.result: Four input bytes form an unsigned 32-bit length representable by 64-bit Int. The length guard proves offset + 12 + length <= bytes.count, and offset advances by at least 12. No unchecked width, height or row-size multiplication exists in these files.

checks.name: Structural rejection and termination
checks.result: Requires first chunk IHDR of length 13; rejects duplicate IHDR, nonletter type bytes, incomplete headers/payloads/trailers, missing nonempty IDAT, nonzero IEND payload, absent IEND, trailing bytes and unknown critical chunks. IEND returns only when it ends exactly at input end.

checks.name: Retained bytes and CRC
checks.result: Copies complete retained chunks byte-for-byte, including their original CRC bytes. CRC recalculation or verification is deliberately absent under the fresh-platform-encoding contract. Retained color/transparency chunks include sRGB, gAMA, cHRM, iCCP and tRNS. Text/EXIF and unknown ancillary chunks are dropped.

checks.name: Existing test coverage
checks.result: Three XCTest methods cover removal of eXIf/tEXt/iTXt/zTXt, sRGB preservation, idempotence, six malformed/trailing cases, unknown critical rejection and configured byte-limit rejection. Test fixtures explicitly use synthetic zero CRCs and do not claim valid pixel decoding.

checks.name: Encoding-specific requested checks
checks.result: PNG dimensions, row sizes, scanline filter bytes, Adler checksum and deflate block construction are inapplicable: neither scoped file encodes images, decompresses IDAT or interprets IHDR dimensions.

checks.name: Contract/startup documentation
checks.method: Read mandatory startup documents and m02-m03-code-v2
checks.result: Preserved scope and evidence limits. M03 remains active in the inspected state; this review makes no milestone or runtime-acceptance claim.
